description: Continues a search that was begun with the {@link ApiRange#Find} method. Finds the previous cell that matches those same conditions and returns the ApiRange object that represents that cell. This does not affect the selection or the active cell.

params.description: The cell before which the search will start. If this argument is not specified, the search starts from the last cell found.
params.name: Before

returns.description: Returns null if the range does not contain such text.
